title: About Candles Falling Through the Gilt Arch
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @RtClick_Save: Do a deep dive into the Avant NFT scene by reading @gardenparty85's history o.... Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Candles Falling Through the Gilt Arch: Gilt reliquary crash world: off-center aperture with floating counterweight, frontal flat plate. One oversized Gothic gilt triple arch, pinnacles cropped at the top edge, sits left of center; through its openings, glowing vermilion and acid-green candlestick strokes fall across tarred wrinkled canvas, ending in a sm... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Gilt Gothic triple-arch altarpiece framing falling candlestick chart.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
